Đây là 4 ảnh @Gemini_Generated_Image_xfvrlhxfvrlhxfvr.png @Gemini_Generated_Image_nyi3innyi3innyi3.png @Gemini_Generated_Image_56pnqb56pnqb56pn.png @Gemini_Generated_Image_gqksegqksegqkseg.png 
Build ONLY SECTION 2 of the landing page for a modern children's education center.

SECTION CONCEPT:
"Four real learning experiences placed naturally on a clean white creative desk."

The section introduces four learning programs through four authentic photographs.
It must NOT look like a conventional service-card section.

==================================================
1. SECTION STRUCTURE
==================================================

The section consists of ONLY:

1. Section heading
2. Short supporting sentence
3. Four square photographs
4. Sparse decorative doodles on the white background

Nothing else.

Do NOT add:
- CTA
- buttons
- testimonials
- pricing
- navigation
- footer
- extra sections
- service cards
- large descriptions
- icons

==================================================
2. BACKGROUND
==================================================

Background:
Pure white #FFFFFF.

The section should visually resemble a clean white tabletop / paper surface.

Keep approximately 90% of the canvas visually empty.

Add sparse handmade decorative elements scattered naturally across the section.

Use a MIX of:
- tiny irregular organic shapes
- small imperfect circles
- tiny outlined stars
- four-point sparkles
- small dots
- subtle paint strokes
- miniature color swatches
- abstract paper-like shapes
- tiny geometric fragments
- short pencil marks
- small curved marks
- tiny playful bursts

The decorations must feel handmade and slightly imperfect.

Colors:
- very light graphite gray
- dusty pink
- muted burgundy
- subtle warm gray

Opacity / visual intensity:
20–35%.

IMPORTANT:
The decorative elements are NOT connected to the photographs.

Do NOT create:
- a path connecting the photographs
- directional arrows
- repeating patterns
- borders
- central illustrations
- large doodles
- recognizable characters
- classroom illustrations
- letters
- numbers
- educational icons

The decorations are simply scattered naturally across the white space.

==================================================
3. SECTION HEADING
==================================================

Place the heading near the top center.

Headline:

"Chọn lớp học phù hợp với con"

Supporting sentence:

"Mỗi độ tuổi và nhu cầu đều có một cách học phù hợp."

Typography:
- modern
- friendly
- editorial
- clean
- slightly playful
- dark burgundy heading
- soft dark-neutral supporting text

Do not make the heading enormous.

The heading should occupy approximately the top 15–18% of the section.

==================================================
4. SECTION SIZE
==================================================

Desktop:
1440px wide.

Section height:
approximately 1150–1250px.

Use generous vertical whitespace.

The four photographs should occupy most of the visual body of the section.

Do NOT try to compress all four photographs into a 700–800px standard section.

==================================================
5. FOUR PHOTOGRAPHS
==================================================

Use FOUR REALISTIC 1:1 SQUARE PHOTOGRAPHS.

Every photograph must remain a true square.

Never skew or distort the photographs.

Only rotate the entire square.

All four photographs must share the same photographic language:

- authentic documentary photography
- real classroom environment
- natural lighting
- realistic Vietnamese children
- natural expressions
- candid moments
- subtle premium editorial quality
- realistic skin and proportions
- no artificial AI-looking faces
- no staged stock-photo aesthetic

The four photographs must show DIFFERENT LEARNING BEHAVIORS.

Do NOT make all four images show:
"teacher standing beside child and teaching."

==================================================
6. PHOTO A — ART
==================================================

Program:
"Lớp học vẽ"

Behavior:
CHILD CREATES.

Scene:
A Vietnamese child around 7–10 years old independently creating a drawing.

The child is focused on their own artwork and actively experimenting with colors and shapes.

The child is the visual subject.

A teacher may appear subtly in the distant background, but must NOT directly guide the child's hands.

Show:
- drawing paper
- colors / crayons / paint materials
- partially completed child artwork
- natural classroom environment

The visual message is:

"Con được tự mình khám phá và tạo ra."

Geometry:
- 300 × 300px
- upper-left area
- approximately x: 13%
- approximately y: 23%
- rotation: -6°

==================================================
7. PHOTO B — ENGLISH
==================================================

Program:
"Tiếng Anh giao tiếp"

Behavior:
CHILD COMMUNICATES.

Scene:
A Vietnamese child actively communicating with a foreign English teacher.

The child is speaking or responding naturally using facial expression and simple gestures.

The teacher listens and responds.

This must look like genuine two-way communication.

Do NOT make the scene about a textbook or vocabulary flashcards.

Show:
- eye contact
- gestures
- conversational body language
- natural classroom/activity space

The visual message is:

"Con thực sự sử dụng tiếng Anh."

Geometry:
- 340 × 340px
- upper-right area
- approximately x: 63%
- approximately y: 18%
- rotation: +5°

==================================================
8. PHOTO C — TUTORING
==================================================

Program:
"Gia sư các cấp"

Behavior:
STUDENT ↔ TUTOR EXCHANGE.

Scene:
A Vietnamese student is actively discussing a problem with a tutor in a one-to-one learning environment.

The student has asked or pointed out something.

The tutor responds and explains.

Both are actively participating in the conversation.

Do NOT show a teacher simply pointing at a notebook while the student silently listens.

Show:
- natural eye contact
- gestures
- student's work
- genuine back-and-forth interaction

The visual message is:

"Con được lắng nghe và hỗ trợ theo nhu cầu của mình."

Geometry:
- 290 × 290px
- central area
- approximately x: 43%
- approximately y: 43%
- rotation: -3°

This photograph is the visual center of gravity of the composition.

==================================================
9. PHOTO D — PRE-PRIMARY + HANDWRITING
==================================================

Program:
"Tiền tiểu học + luyện chữ đẹp"

Behavior:
CHILD PRACTICES.

Scene:
A Vietnamese child around 5–6 years old independently practicing handwriting.

The child carefully holds a pencil and concentrates on writing.

A teacher may appear naturally in the background, but must NOT directly hold the child's hand or teach the child in the foreground.

Show:
- handwriting practice sheets
- pencil
- comfortable learning posture
- simple learning materials
- calm classroom environment

The visual message is:

"Con hình thành kỹ năng qua việc thực hành."

The atmosphere must feel encouraging, not pressured.

Geometry:
- 320 × 320px
- lower-left area
- approximately x: 16%
- approximately y: 64%
- rotation: +6°

==================================================
10. PHOTO LABELS
==================================================

Do NOT turn the photographs into cards.

If program names are displayed, use small editorial captions near the photographs.

Use:

"Lớp học vẽ"

"Tiếng Anh giao tiếp"

"Gia sư các cấp"

"Tiền tiểu học + luyện chữ đẹp"

Captions should be:
- small
- simple
- dark burgundy / neutral
- visually secondary
- positioned naturally near the corresponding photograph

No boxes.
No background containers.
No card styling.

==================================================
11. PHOTO COMPOSITION
==================================================

Do NOT use a 2×2 grid.

Do NOT align:
- edges
- centers
- baselines
- spacing

The composition must feel intentionally irregular.

Approximate visual flow:

                 ENGLISH
                    ↘

      ART       →   TUTORING
                       ↙

              PRE-PRIMARY

The four photographs should feel like physical photographs casually placed on a white desk.

Allow slight overlap between some photographs:
approximately 20–40px where visually appropriate.

Never hide important photographic content.

==================================================
12. SHADOWS
==================================================

Each photograph may have an extremely subtle soft physical shadow.

The shadow should communicate:
"photograph resting on a white surface."

Very soft.
Very low contrast.

Do NOT use:
- dramatic drop shadows
- glowing shadows
- floating card shadows
- colored shadows

==================================================
13. ENTRANCE ANIMATION
==================================================

When Section 2 enters the viewport, photographs should appear as if gently placed onto the white surface.

INITIAL:

ART:
translate(-35px, 20px)
rotate(-10°)

ENGLISH:
translate(40px, -20px)
rotate(+10°)

TUTORING:
translate(0px, 30px)
rotate(-6°)

PRE-PRIMARY:
translate(-30px, 30px)
rotate(+10°)

FINAL:

ART:
rotate(-6°)

ENGLISH:
rotate(+5°)

TUTORING:
rotate(-3°)

PRE-PRIMARY:
rotate(+6°)

Animation:
- 700–900ms
- stagger 80–140ms
- natural smooth easing
- very slight physical settling

The animation should feel like:
"four photographs gently landing on a desk."

Do NOT use:
- spinning
- dramatic zoom
- bouncing
- floating
- continuous rotation
- aggressive parallax

After entering:
photographs remain essentially still.

==================================================
14. RESPONSIVE
==================================================

TABLET:
Maintain the scattered composition but reduce photograph sizes.

MOBILE:
Do NOT compress the desktop composition into one viewport.

Stack the photographs vertically with intentionally irregular horizontal positioning.

Keep each photograph square.

Preserve their slight rotations.

Maintain generous white space.

The mobile section should still feel like photographs casually placed on a white surface.

==================================================
15. STRICT VISUAL CONSTRAINTS
==================================================

DO NOT CREATE:

- conventional 2×2 cards
- service cards
- rectangular image cards
- parallelogram images
- skewed images
- distorted photographs
- Polaroid frames
- thick borders
- excessive shadows
- gradients
- colored background
- large illustrations
- cartoon characters
- excessive pastel decoration
- repeating patterns
- giant typography
- stock-photo collage
- floating UI cards
- CTA
- buttons
- unrelated content

FINAL VISUAL PRINCIPLE:

PURE WHITE SPACE
+
SMALL HANDMADE DOODLES
+
FOUR REAL SQUARE PHOTOGRAPHS
+
FOUR DIFFERENT LEARNING BEHAVIORS
+
SLIGHT ROTATION
+
ASYMMETRICAL PHYSICAL PLACEMENT
+
SUBTLE "PHOTO ON DESK" ANIMATION.

The result should feel creative, tactile, child-friendly and modern, while remaining clean and premium.
